Where to Stay in Spain: Hotels, Boutique Inns & Stays

Comparing city hotels, historic boutique inns, alpine/coastal lodges, and apartment rentals in Spain.

Last reviewed: October 23, 2026 · Prices are approximate and for orientation only.

On this page

  1. Key takeaways for first-time visitors
  2. Step-by-step practical advice
  3. Common mistakes to avoid

Comparing city hotels, historic boutique inns, alpine/coastal lodges, and apartment rentals in Spain.

Key takeaways for first-time visitors

  • Official transport: Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail connects Madrid, Barcelona, and Seville with frequent daily departures.
  • Payments: Contactless Visa/Mastercard and mobile wallets are widely accepted across Spain, alongside small cash in EUR (€) for rural buses and bakeries.
  • Power & connectivity: Spain uses Types C & F (230V / 50Hz). Install an eSIM before departure so rail apps and maps work as soon as you land.

Step-by-step practical advice

When planning your route through Spain, anchor your itinerary around 2 or 3 main bases (Madrid, Barcelona, and Seville) and use regional trains for scenic day trips into our complete directory of every municipality in Spain.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Overpacking your schedule with one-night hotel hops instead of using Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail for day trips.
  • Waiting until the day of travel to book peak-season high-speed trains or timed-entry museum tickets.
  • Accepting Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) on card terminals — always choose to be charged in local currency (EUR).

Frequently asked questions

What is the most important tip for where to stay in spain: hotels, boutique inns & stays?

Book flagship Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail trains and major museum timed-entry tickets ahead of time, and keep both a contactless card and a small reserve of EUR (€) cash.

Where can I verify official rules for Spain?

Check the official national tourism portal (https://www.spain.info/en/) and national rail operator (https://www.renfe.com/es/en) before departure.

Official sources & further reading

Rules, prices and schedules change. Confirm details here before you travel:
